name: Wentel Engineering Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，Wentel Engineering Holdings Berhad 提出以 RM29.58 million 向关联方 Twin Galaxy Development Sdn Bhd 收购位于 Johor Bahru 的 Galaxy Industrial Park 的两间中型工业半独立式工厂，以扩大金属加工与组装业务的产能；该收购的条件期限已延长至 2026年12月17日。公司未公告新增或退出业务线。
overview_en: In 2026, Wentel Engineering Holdings Berhad proposed to acquire two medium industrial semi-detached factories in Galaxy Industrial Park, Johor Bahru, from related party Twin Galaxy Development Sdn Bhd for RM29.58 million, expanding capacity for its metal fabrication and assembly operations; the conditional period for the acquisition was extended to 17 December 2026. No new business lines or exits were announced.

segments.name: 金属加工服务
segments.note: 公司提出收购两间中型工业半独立式工厂，以扩大金属加工业务的产能。
segments.note_en: The company proposed to acquire two medium industrial semi-detached factories to expand capacity for its metal fabrication operations.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 收购事项的条件期限由 2026年6月17日延长6个月至 2026年12月17日，以达成先决条件。
actions.text_en: The conditional period for the acquisition was extended by 6 months from 17 June 2026 to 17 December 2026 to fulfil the conditions precedent.
